thread.title: All 30 Dow stock rise premarket, led by UnitedHealth - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stock rise premarket, led by UnitedHealth - MarketWatch
text: Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.87% components were trading higher, as the three companies reporting earnings gave investors reason to cheer. The gainers were leb by the 2.3% jump in UnitedHealth Group Inc .'s stock UNH, +2.69% after the insurer beat profit and revenue expectation. Johnson & Johnson 's stock JNJ, +0.87% tacked on 0.8% and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. shares GS, +0.77% gained 0.9% after both companies beat profit and sales expectations. Merck & Co. MRK, +2.59% shares were the second-biggest gainer, up 2.0%. Among other more active Dow stocks, Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.62% gained 0.6% and General Electric Co.'s GE, -1.19% tacked o 0.5%. Meanwhile, Dow futures YMM8, +0.89% rallied 217 points.
